Architecture

Spit Fire → Jasper → Koronos → Kore/Spotnik → Aurora → applications. R8192/C8192 and RegisterN remain research/emulation targets rather than claims of existing silicon.

Mobile Edition

Aurora-inspired mobile glass UI with bilingual English/Arabic presentation, system telemetry, applications, store, files, terminal, security and device services.
